fields.name: modification_type
fields.rationale: The wood is chemically modified through acetylation, which enhances its durability against environmental factors.
evidence: The chemical modification of the wood increases the durability of the wood against rot, fungal attack and insect attack.

fields.name: application_environment
fields.rationale: The product is suitable for outdoor use, including soil and water contact, due to its enhanced durability.
evidence: acetylated wood is mainly used outdoors, as well as for applications with soil and water contact.
